description: Stand in an athletic stance with the ball in your right hand, knees bent. Step 1: Dribble the ball low behind your back from right hand to left hand. Step 2: Take a couple of pound dribbles then dribble the ball low behind your back from left hand to right hand. Step 3: Repeat sequence with a few pound dribbles in between each behind the back.
coaching_notes: Snap your wrist, keep the ball behind your hip, eyes up throughout.

description: Start at half court in a deep squat with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Dribble the ball through your legs from right hand to left hand. Step 2: Dribble it back through your legs from left hand to right hand. Step 3: Keep going in a continuous figure-8 pattern without pausing.
coaching_notes: Stay low, pound the ball through your legs, keep knees bent and chest up.

description: Start in an athletic stance with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Dribble the ball through your legs, right hand to left hand. Step 2: Then dribble the ball back between the legs the same way it came, without rapping it around your knee to go through your leg. Step 3: Aim to go continously.
coaching_notes: Push the ball through aggressively, recover quickly to the next dribble.

description: Start inside a tight box (about 4 feet wide) marked on the floor with the ball in your right hand, in a low stance. Step 1: Dribble to the front-right corner and do a crossover to your left hand. Step 2: Dribble to the back-left corner and go between your legs. Step 3: Dribble to the back-right corner and go behind your back, then repeat the box.
coaching_notes: Stay in a low stance, sharp changes at each corner, eyes forward.

description: Start with the ball in your right hand in a low athletic stance. Step 1: Dribble between your legs to your left hand. Step 2: Wrap dribble behind your back, back to your right hand. Step 3: Cross the ball to your opposite hand.
coaching_notes: Wrap is quick, cross covers ground, stay in athletic stance throughout.

description: Start in place with the ball in either hand in a low athletic stance. Step 1: Pick any six dribble moves such as cross, in-and-out, between the legs, behind the back, spin, or hesitation. Step 2: Perform all six moves one after another without stopping. Step 3: Repeat.
coaching_notes: Stay low, eyes up, push pace each set, no carries.

description: Start in a low stance with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Do a front V-dribble — bounce the ball in front of you and out to your right side, then back (like a V shape) to your left side. Step 2: Switch to a side V-dribble — bounce it beside your hip out and back. Step 3: Alternate front V and side V without stopping.
coaching_notes: Spread your fingers wide, control the V with your fingertips, stay low and rhythmic.

description: Start in a low stance with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Dribble the ball through your legs from your right hand to your left. Step 2: Jump in a scissor motion and swap your legs position (make the back leg in front, and the front leg in back). Step 3: Dribble between your legs and repeat.
coaching_notes: Quick feet, small quick dribbles, keep the ball at waist height.

description: Start in a low athletic stance. Step 1: Cross the ball hard to your left hand. Step 2: Cross the ball hard back to your right hand. Step 3: Dribble behind your legs to your left hand.
coaching_notes: Crosses are low and sharp, BTL stays tight through your stride.

description: Start dribbling up the court. Step 1: Dribble fast with your right hand, then do one hard pound dribble on a sudden stop. Step 2: Pause with a hesitation shot fake. Step 3: Explosive cross to your left hand and attack the rim.
coaching_notes: Drag is patient, hesi freezes, cross is the fastest move in the sequence.

description: Start at the baseline with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Push the ball out in front of you and sprint to half court. Step 2: Keep dribbling at full speed — head up, ball controlled. Step 3: Sprint through the finish line at half court without slowing down, then repeat with left hand.
coaching_notes: Push the ball out front, sprint through the finish, keep your head up.

description: Start in place with the ball in your right hand in a deep athletic stance. Step 1: Figure-8 dribble through your legs (two between the legs). Step 2: On every other rep, add a behind-the-back dribble.
coaching_notes: Stay in deep athletic stance, don't watch the ball, snap the behind-the-back.

description: Start at half court in a low stance with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Wrap the ball in a figure 8 through your legs — right hand to left hand. Step 2: Pound the ball hard once with your right hand. Step 3: Wrap figure 8 again, pound with your left hand, and keep alternating.
coaching_notes: Pound hard between wraps, keep the ball tight, eyes up.

description: Start at half court standing tall with the ball in both hands. Step 1: Wrap the ball around your waist as fast as you can — right to left and back. Step 2: Wrap it around your head in circles. Step 3: Wrap it around your legs in circles without letting it touch the ground.
coaching_notes: Quick hands, keep the ball close, don't look down.

description: Start at the baseline with the ball in either hand in a low athletic stance. Step 1: Dribble full court down using at least 4 different moves. Step 2: Dribble full court back using at least 4 more different moves. Step 3: Use 8 different moves total with no repeats until all 8 are done.
coaching_notes: Sprint the straightaways, control the turns, no traveling on the corners.

description: Start at half court in an athletic stance with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Pound the ball hard in a half-circle arc around the front of your body. Step 2: Switch to your left hand at the top of the arc and pound back around. Step 3: Keep the half-circle smooth and the dribble at waist height.
coaching_notes: Pound at waist height, switch hands smoothly, stay in an athletic stance.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand in a low athletic stance. Step 1: Hesitation dribble to freeze the defender. Step 2: Quick cross to your left hand. Step 3: Quick cross back to your right hand. Step 4: Blow by straight to the rim for a layup or pull-up.
coaching_notes: Hesi sells the drive, crosses are tight, last step is long on the blow-by.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand in a low stance. Step 1: Do one in-and-out and then a couple of pound dribbles in between. Step 2: If that's too easy, remove the pound dribbles from the drill.
coaching_notes: Sell with your shoulder, snap the ball out wide, explode past the hip.

exercise_name: In-Out Cross Behind the Back Chain
description: Start with the ball in your right hand in a low athletic stance. Step 1: In-and-out dribble to sell the push. Step 2: Explosive cross to your left hand. Step 3: Dribble behind your back back to your right hand.
coaching_notes: Sell the in-and-out with wrist and shoulder, cross is violent and low.

description: Start by jogging in place. Step 1: Dribble at hip height while keeping your head up. Step 2: Add pound dribbles and other dribble moves while jogging in place until the timer runs out.
coaching_notes: Head up, relaxed dribble at hip height, smooth hand changes.

description: Start at half court with the ball in your right hand in a low athletic stance. Step 1: Cross the ball to your left hand. Step 2: Dribble between your legs back to your right hand. Step 3: Spin move off your inside foot toward open space.
coaching_notes: Spin on the inside foot, ball low through the turn, explode out of the spin.

exercise_name: Lateral Dribble with Thru the Legs
description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand in a low stance. Step 1: Shuffle two steps to your right while dribbling. Step 2: Push the ball through your legs to your left hand. Step 3: Shuffle two steps left and push it back through your legs.
coaching_notes: Stay low in the lateral slide, push the ball through hard, recover quickly.

description: Start at half court with the ball in your right hand in a defensive-style stance. Step 1: Slide two steps to your right while pounding the dribble — don't cross your feet. Step 2: Switch to your left hand and slide two steps left. Step 3: Keep sliding back and forth at waist height with your eyes up.
coaching_notes: Don't cross feet on defense-style slides, pound at waist height, eyes up.

description: Start at half court in an athletic stance with the ball in your right hand (or no ball for footwork only). Step 1: Push off your left foot and hop/slide to the right — like a speed skater. Step 2: Land softly on your right foot and immediately push off to slide back left. Step 3: Stay low and keep your chest up the whole time.
coaching_notes: Push off the outside leg, stay low, land softly on each rep.

description: Start at half court in a deep squat with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Dribble a figure 8 around your legs — keep the ball below your knees. Step 2: Switch hands smoothly at the front and back of each wrap. Step 3: Stay low the entire time — don't stand up.
coaching_notes: Stay in a deep squat, quick hands, keep the ball below the knees.

description: Start at half court in a low athletic stance with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Pound the ball hard at ankle or knee height. Step 2: Use your fingertips to control every bounce. Step 3: Keep your chest up and eyes forward — don't stare at the ball.
coaching_notes: Fingertips control the ball, pound with purpose, chest up and eyes forward.

description: Start at half court with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Step forward into a deep lunge with your right foot while dribbling with your right hand. Step 2: Push back up to standing through your heel. Step 3: Switch — lunge forward with your left foot while dribbling with your left hand.
coaching_notes: Keep the ball on the outside hand, chest up, push back up through the heel.

description: Start at half court with the ball in your right hand in a low athletic stance in front of zigzag cones. Step 1: Weave through the cones using in-and-out and cross moves only. Step 2: Attack the outside shoulder of each cone. Step 3: Plant your foot and explode to the next cone.
coaching_notes: Plant foot points at the next cone, ball stays outside the body on the turn.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Take one hard dribble to your right. Step 2: Crossover low and quick to your left hand. Step 3: Explode past your imaginary defender.
coaching_notes: Low crossover, push off the outside foot, explode after the change.

description: Start at half court in a low squat with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Tap the ball quickly with your right fingertips — light, fast taps like popcorn popping. Step 2: Switch to your left hand and tap just as fast. Step 3: Keep alternating hands without letting the ball bounce above your knees.
coaching_notes: Quick light taps, stay low, keep the ball in front of your body.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand in a low athletic stance. Step 1: Two setup pound dribbles at shoulder height. Step 2: One cross to your left hand at knee height. Step 3: One between-the-legs dribble back to your right hand.
coaching_notes: Pounds are shoulder height, cross and BTL are knee height, eyes on the rim.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand in a low athletic stance. Step 1: Setup pound dribble. Step 2: Cross the ball to your left hand. Step 3: Dribble between your legs back to your right hand. Step 4: Dribble behind your back to your left hand.
coaching_notes: Don't rush the setup pound; accelerate through the last two moves.

description: Start at half court in an athletic stance with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Pound the ball hard at waist to knee height. Step 2: Use your fingertips to control every bounce — not your palm. Step 3: Keep your eyes up and chest facing forward.
coaching_notes: Pound at waist to knee height, fingertips control, eyes up.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand in a low stance. Step 1: Do two quick light taps with your right hand. Step 2: Crossover to your left hand. Step 3: Push the ball through your legs back to your right hand and explode forward.
coaching_notes: Quick hands, stay low, explode out of the last dribble.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand in a low athletic stance. Step 1: Take two retreat dribbles toward half court. Step 2: Cross the ball hard to your left hand. Step 3: Explode at full speed toward the rim.
coaching_notes: Retreat is controlled, cross is low and hard, eyes up on the re-attack.

exercise_name: Reverse walk and behind the back
description: Start at the free-throw line with the ball in your right hand, facing the basket. Step 1: Begin walking backward toward half court. Step 2: Dribble behind your back to switch to your left hand. Step 3: Keep walking backward and switch back behind your back to your right hand.
coaching_notes: Stay low backing up, snap the behind-the-back clean, eyes up.

description: Start at the free-throw line with the ball in your right hand, facing the basket. Step 1: Begin walking backward with small controlled steps. Step 2: Push the ball through your legs to your left hand. Step 3: Keep walking backward and push it back through your legs to your right hand.
coaching_notes: Small controlled steps back, push the ball through your legs, chest up.

description: Start at half court in an athletic stance with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Pound the ball hard 5 times with your right hand. Step 2: Switch to your left hand and pound 5 times. Step 3: Keep alternating — equal height and force on both hands.
coaching_notes: Equal height and force on both hands, stay in an athletic stance.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand in a low defensive stance. Step 1: Defensive shuffle two steps to the right while dribbling. Step 2: Cross the ball to your left hand. Step 3: Dribble between your legs back to your right hand. Step 4: Dribble behind your back to your left hand and explode forward.
coaching_notes: Shuffle stays low, chain is continuous, explode after the behind-the-back.

description: Start in place with the ball in your right hand in a low athletic stance. Step 1: V-dribble at the side of your body outside your knee. Step 2: Cross the ball to your left hand. Step 3: Dribble between your legs back to your right hand.
coaching_notes: V-dribble at knee height, don't stand up between moves.

description: Start at half court standing on your left leg with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Wrap the ball in circles around your right ankle and knee as fast as you can. Step 2: Stay balanced — don't put your other foot down. Step 3: Switch — stand on your right leg and wrap around your left leg.
coaching_notes: Quick wraps around the ankle and knee, stay balanced on the plant leg.

description: Start at half court in a wide, low stance with the ball in front of you. Step 1: Tap the ball with your right hand in front of your right foot. Step 2: Tap it with your left hand in front of your left foot. Step 3: Tap it with your right hand behind your right foot, then left behind your left foot — keep all four taps going in a rhythm.
coaching_notes: Wide base, quick taps with fingertips, keep the ball in front.

exercise_name: Through the Legs behind the back
description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand in a low stance. Step 1: Push the ball through your legs to your left hand. Step 2: Immediately wrap it behind your back back to your right hand. Step 3: Slide your feet sideways and keep the combo going smoothly.
coaching_notes: Stay low, smooth transition between moves, eyes up the whole time.

exercise_name: Tween Cross Tween Behind the Back
description: Start at half court or in place with the ball in your right hand in a low athletic stance. Step 1: In-and-out dribble with your right hand. Step 2: Cross the ball to your left hand. Step 3: In-and-out dribble with your left hand. Step 4: Dribble behind your back back to your right hand.
coaching_notes: Pound each move, eyes up, behind-the-back snaps at hip height.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Take two controlled setup dribbles to your right. Step 2: Crossover low and hard to your left hand. Step 3: Explode past your imaginary defender or pull up for a shot.
coaching_notes: Controlled setup dribbles, sharp crossover, explode on the change.

description: Start at half court in a low stance with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Bounce the ball in a V shape in front of you — out to your right and back to center. Step 2: Switch to a side V — bounce it beside your hip out and back. Step 3: Alternate front V and side V without stopping.
coaching_notes: Fingertip control, keep the V tight, stay low and rhythmic.

description: Start at the baseline with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Walk forward at a smooth pace down the court. Step 2: Dribble behind your back to switch to your left hand. Step 3: Keep walking and switch back behind your back to your right hand.
coaching_notes: Snap your wrist behind the back, keep eyes up, smooth walking pace.

description: Start at the baseline with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Walk forward at a smooth pace. Step 2: Push the ball through your legs to your left hand. Step 3: Keep walking and push it back through your legs to your right hand.
coaching_notes: Push the ball through your legs, stay low, don't look at the ball.

description: Start at the baseline with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Walk or jog forward down the court. Step 2: Crossover to your left hand. Step 3: Cross back to your right hand and keep going.
coaching_notes: Low crossover, push off the outside foot, keep the ball protected.

description: Start at the baseline on the right sideline with the ball in your right hand and cones set in a zig-zag pattern to half court. Step 1: Dribble toward the first cone. Step 2: Crossover to your left hand and change direction toward the next cone. Step 3: Cross back at each cone until you reach half court.
coaching_notes: Stay low on each change, push off the outside foot, eyes up.

description: On the catch, read whether the closeout is a fly-by (attack) or a hard contest (shot). One-dribble decision into shot, drive, or extra pass.
coaching_notes: Footwork ready on the catch, decide in the first 0.5 seconds.

description: Simulate a ball screen: read ice, drop, switch, or blitz coverage and choose pull-up, pocket pass, or reject. Mental rep for the most common NBA action.
coaching_notes: Read the big's coverage first, then the weak-side tag.

description: Visualize help rotating from the weak side on your drive — pass to the corner, skip to the opposite wing, or finish if they late-rotate. Decision-making rep without live teammates.
coaching_notes: Eyes up on the drive, decide before you pick the ball up.

description: Full-court transition rep: fill the lane wide, read rim runner vs trailer three vs pitch ahead. Trains the decision tree in primary/fast break.
coaching_notes: Sprint the first three steps, eyes up the floor, one sound decision.

description: Start on one sideline in an athletic stance. Step 1: Sprint sideline to sideline (17 feet). Step 2: Touch the far line. Step 3: Sprint back and touch the start line.
coaching_notes: Full effort every rep, full recovery between, track your times.

description: Start at the baseline in an athletic stance. Step 1: Touch the backboard or rim. Step 2: Sprint to half court and touch the line. Step 3: Sprint back for an imaginary rebound.
coaching_notes: Explode on the first three steps, touch every line, game-speed effort.

description: Start at the top of the key in an athletic stance. Step 1: Sprint closeout to the corner. Step 2: Defensive slide along the baseline to the other corner. Step 3: Sprint back to the top of the key.
coaching_notes: Sprint the closeout, slide low on the baseline, don't stand up.

description: Start on one side of the lane in a low defensive stance. Step 1: Defensive slide across the lane width. Step 2: Touch the sideline. Step 3: Slide back across the lane.
coaching_notes: Stay low the entire rep, hands up, don't hop between slides.

description: Start at the baseline with the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: Speed dribble full court down at max pace. Step 2: Speed dribble full court back with controlled handle. Step 3: Walk back to recover.
coaching_notes: Sprint through the finish, handle stays sharp, walk back fully.

description: Start at the baseline in an athletic stance. Step 1: Sprint to the near free throw line and back. Step 2: Sprint to the far free throw line and back. Step 3: Sprint to half court and back.
coaching_notes: Plant and go at each line, don't round corners, touch every line.

description: Start at half court in an athletic stance. Step 1: Sprint to touch the near-basket circle. Step 2: Jog back to half court. Step 3: Repeat the sprint and jog back.
coaching_notes: Touch inside the circle, sprint in, jog back, maintain form when tired.

description: Start at the baseline in an athletic stance. Step 1: Sprint the right lane full court and touch the front rim. Step 2: Walk back to recover. Step 3: Sprint the left lane full court and touch the front rim.
coaching_notes: Sprint the first three steps every trip, touch the rim, walk back recovery.

description: Start under the rim in a low defensive stance with no ball. Step 1: Sprint closeout to the imaginary shooter on the wing with high hands. Step 2: Chop your feet on arrival. Step 3: Mirror one dribble middle or baseline without fouling. Step 4: Contest the pull-up shot.
coaching_notes: Closeout under control, no hopping, slide on the drive, hand up on the shot.

description: Start at the top of the key in a low defensive stance with no ball. Step 1: Sprint to the corner closeout. Step 2: Arrive with high hands and chop your feet. Step 3: Contest the imaginary three without flying by.
coaching_notes: Sprint then chop, high hands, don't leave your feet on the shot fake.

description: Start under the basket in a defensive stance, facing a shooter on the right wing. Step 1: Sprint out toward the shooter on the wing. Step 2: Chop your last few steps — shorten your stride so you don't fly past them. Step 3: Raise one hand high to contest the shot without jumping into them.
coaching_notes: Sprint, chop the last steps, high hand contest, stay balanced.

description: Start on the weak side in help position in a low defensive stance. Step 1: On the post catch, dig with a quick step and hand. Step 2: Sprint recover to your man on the kick. Step 3: Find the ball and your man.
coaching_notes: Dig is short and violent, recover with sprint, find the ball and your man.

description: Start on the ball side of an imaginary middle pick-and-roll in a low defensive stance. Step 1: Go over the screen. Step 2: Let the big drop to the near-basket circle. Step 3: Trail and recover to contest the pull-up or pass to the roller.
coaching_notes: Fight over the screen, don't die on the reject, communicate with the big.

description: Start on the right block with your back to the basket, ball in both hands in a post stance. Step 1: Feel the imaginary defender on your right hip. Step 2: Drop step with your left foot — swing it wide toward the baseline to spin around the defender. Step 3: Power up and finish with a layup or short hook.
coaching_notes: Drop step wide, seal with your body, finish strong at the rim.

description: Start on the wing in a low defensive stance with your hand in the passing lane. Step 1: Deny the catch with your butt to the ball. Step 2: Force the catch further out. Step 3: Shuffle with the imaginary cutter.
coaching_notes: Ball-side low stance, active feet, hands up, don't reach-in foul.

description: Start on the ball side of an imaginary side ball screen in a low defensive stance. Step 1: Force the ballhandler baseline. Step 2: Drop step with the imaginary big. Step 3: Keep your weak-side stunt ready on the roll.
coaching_notes: Communicate 'ice' out loud, stunt don't over-help, recover on the pass.

description: Start on the ball-side block in a low defensive stance with the ball on the wing. Step 1: Front the post player chest to chest with your hand in the lane. Step 2: When the ball goes above the break, move to three-quarter from the top. Step 3: Keep one hand on the post and one in the passing lane.
coaching_notes: Communicate with help, dig on the lob, don't let the post catch deep.

description: Start on the left block in a low defensive stance, facing the baseline. Step 1: Push off your back foot (left foot) and slide your right foot over — don't cross your feet. Step 2: Slide across the lane to the right block in a low stance. Step 3: Push step back the other direction.
coaching_notes: Push off the back foot, stay low, don't cross your feet.

description: Start at half court in a defensive stance — butt down, chest up, weight on the balls of your feet. Step 1: Hold the stance and do quick foot taps in place as fast as you can. Step 2: On a coach's call or after 5 seconds, explode into a sprint or slide. Step 3: Reset and hold the stance again.
coaching_notes: Butt down, chest up, weight on the balls of your feet, active hands.

description: Shell defense rotation: start under the rim, close out, rotate on pass, help the helper. Continuous 30–45 second reps building team defensive habits solo.
coaching_notes: Talk on every pass, point and communicate, sprint the closeout.

description: Start under the rim in a low defensive stance with no ball. Step 1: Sprint closeout to the corner. Step 2: Imagine a pass to the wing and rotate. Step 3: Close out to the wing. Step 4: Imagine a drive, help, and recover.
coaching_notes: Call 'ball' and 'help' out loud, point on every pass, sprint closeouts.

description: Start in help position on the weak side in a low defensive stance. Step 1: On the drive, stunt by stepping toward the ball with high hands. Step 2: Sprint recover to the corner shooter on the kick. Step 3: Close out and contest the three.
coaching_notes: Stunt with high hands, don't leave your feet, close out on the kick.

description: Start on the baseline in a low defensive stance with no ball. Step 1: Defensive slide through the lane in a figure-8 or weave pattern. Step 2: Touch each elbow. Step 3: Stay low the whole time.
coaching_notes: Hands up, hips low, don't bounce, push off the outside foot.

description: Start under the basket on the right side with the ball in your right hand, standing on your left foot. Step 1: Jump off your left foot and lay the ball softly off the backboard with your right hand. Step 2: Catch the rebound on the left side with your left hand. Step 3: Jump off your right foot and finish with your left hand off the backboard.
coaching_notes: Use the backboard, stay on one foot, snap your wrist on every finish.

description: Start on the right block with the ball in both hands in an athletic stance. Step 1: Take one step toward the basket with your left foot (outside foot). Step 2: Gather the ball and jump off that left foot. Step 3: Finish with your right hand (inside hand) high off the backboard.
coaching_notes: Step with the outside foot, protect the ball with your body, finish high.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive hard into the right side of the paint. Step 2: Take two controlled retreat dribbles to create space. Step 3: Step forward and shoot a right-lane floater.
coaching_notes: Attack with purpose, retreat under control, finish with eyes on the square.

description: Start on the wing with the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: Attack the baseline. Step 2: Jump stop under the rim when help cuts you off. Step 3: Extend with a long reverse finish on the opposite side with your arm fully extended.
coaching_notes: Jump stop is balanced, extend fully, expect contact on the way up.

description: Start under the basket on the right side with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Jump off your left foot and lay the ball softly off the backboard — stay balanced and controlled, don't rush. Step 2: Catch the rebound on the left side. Step 3: Jump off your right foot and finish with your left hand, keeping your body square and steady.
coaching_notes: Keep your body under control, use the glass, finish with the inside hand.

exercise_name: Closed Eyed Finishing (Fun Way to end workout)
description: Start two steps in front of the rim on the right side with the ball in your right hand, eyes open first. Step 1: Take one dribble toward the basket. Step 2: Close your eyes. Step 3: Finish with a layup using touch and muscle memory — feel the backboard.
coaching_notes: Trust your footwork, soft touch off the glass, slow down before the finish.

description: Start on the wing with the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: Drive toward the basket. Step 2: Imagine bumping the defender's shoulder at the gather. Step 3: Jump off your inside foot and finish through contact with your outside hand.
coaching_notes: Initiate legal contact with shoulder, finish high, expect the bump.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive hard to the right side of the basket. Step 2: Gather the ball with both hands in a high cradle (like holding a baby) to protect it from a bump. Step 3: Extend through contact and finish the layup.
coaching_notes: Gather high, absorb contact, extend through the finish.

description: Start on one side under the rim with the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: Attack under the rim. Step 2: Cradle the ball with both hands. Step 3: Reverse finish on the other side while absorbing contact.
coaching_notes: Cradle protects the ball, reverse is slow and controlled, use the glass.

description: Start on the wing with the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: Drive full speed toward the middle. Step 2: Take a long first step. Step 3: Take a long second step around the imaginary help defender. Step 4: Finish with your outside hand on the opposite side of the rim.
coaching_notes: Long-long steps, ball high through the euro, finish off the outside hand.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive toward the right side of the rim — take a long first step with your right foot. Step 2: Plant your right foot and step long across with your left foot (euro step) to go around an imaginary defender. Step 3: Release a one-hand floater before you land.
coaching_notes: Long first step, quick second step across, release the floater early.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Attack the right side of the basket with a hard dribble. Step 2: Take a long step with your right foot, then step across with your left foot (euro step) to dodge the defender. Step 3: Finish with a layup on the left side of the rim.
coaching_notes: Sell the drive, step long then across, protect the ball on the finish.

description: Start in the paint with the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: One-foot gather against imaginary length. Step 2: High-ball flick finish with your outside hand. Step 3: Release at the peak before the block arrives.
coaching_notes: Release high, soft touch, expect bump on the way up.

exercise_name: Flick Finishes Above Square Layups( Good for Touch)
description: Start on the right side of the basket about 3 feet away with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Take one step toward the rim. Step 2: Jump off your left foot and flick the ball softly with one hand. Step 3: Aim for the spot above the square on the backboard — let it drop in.
coaching_notes: Use backspin, aim above the square, extend fully through the flick.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive hard down the left side of the lane. Step 2: Pick up your dribble in the paint and jump off your right foot. Step 3: Release a one-hand floater high over the imaginary help defender.
coaching_notes: Get downhill early, float it high off the glass, soft wrist snap.

description: Start at the free-throw line with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Take one or two dribbles toward the right side of the lane. Step 2: Jump off both feet (a 'hop') and gather the ball at the same time. Step 3: Release a floater at the peak of your jump before landing.
coaching_notes: Hop on balance, release at the peak, use the backboard when available.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive directly into the right side of the paint. Step 2: Pick up your dribble before reaching the restricted area. Step 3: Push a one-hand right-lane floater with a high arc and soft touch.
coaching_notes: High arc, soft touch, release before the defender arrives.

description: Start at the free-throw line extended on the right wing with the ball. Step 1: Spin the ball to yourself at the right-wing mid-range spot. Step 2: Step into the catch and set both feet toward the basket. Step 3: Shoot the right-wing mid-range jumper without dribbling.
coaching_notes: Set your feet on the catch, rise straight up, no fade unless scripted.

description: Start inside a small box marked on the floor with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Make a crossover, between-the-legs dribble, and behind-the-back dribble inside the box. Step 2: Explode out of the box to the right with one hard dribble. Step 3: Drive to the rim and finish a right-side layup.
coaching_notes: Stay low in the box, explode out with a decisive move, eyes up.

description: Start in the lane with the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: One-foot gather in the paint. Step 2: Shoot a floater with high backboard touch. Step 3: Aim for the top corner of the square so the ball drops through.
coaching_notes: High arc, hit the top of the square, soft touch off the index finger.

description: Start on the right wing with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive at a 45-degree angle toward the right side of the basket. Step 2: Jump off your left foot as you approach the rim. Step 3: Finish with your right hand (the inside hand — closest to the rim) extended high off the backboard.
coaching_notes: Extend with the inside hand, use the backboard, protect with your off arm.

description: Start under the basket on the right side with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Jump off your left foot and 'spill' a soft inside-hand layup off the backboard. Step 2: Catch the rebound on the left side. Step 3: Jump off your right foot and spill it in with your left hand.
coaching_notes: Quick feet under the rim, soft spill off the glass, alternate sides every rep.

description: Start on the wing with the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: Drive toward the basket. Step 2: Rip the ball low below the defender's hip on the inside. Step 3: Take one dribble. Step 4: Finish with your outside hand on the opposite side.
coaching_notes: Rip is below the knee, shoulder through the hip, high finish with extension.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Attack the right side of the basket with two hard dribbles. Step 2: Gather and jump off your left foot. Step 3: Finish a right-hand layup high off the backboard.
coaching_notes: Attack at an angle, jump off the correct foot, finish high off glass.

description: Start on the wing with the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: Drive toward the middle. Step 2: Jump stop at the near-basket circle on two feet. Step 3: Shoot a one-handed baby hook off your inside shoulder.
coaching_notes: Hook off inside shoulder, soft touch, backboard when available.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive toward the right side of the basket. Step 2: Before you jump, drop low — touch your knee to the floor or get as low as you can on the gather. Step 3: Extend up fully and finish at the rim.
coaching_notes: Stay low on the gather, extend fully through the finish, use the glass.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive down the right side of the lane. Step 2: Pick up your dribble in the paint and jump off your left foot. Step 3: Release a floater using ONLY your left hand — high arc, soft touch.
coaching_notes: Comfortable left-hand release, high arc, soft touch off the glass.

description: Start at the free-throw line with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Dribble toward the right side of the lane. Step 2: Hop off both feet and gather the ball. Step 3: Release a floater with ONLY your left hand at the peak of your jump.
coaching_notes: Hop on balance, left hand only, release at the peak of the jump.

description: Start under the basket on the right side with the ball in your right hand — a partner or coach stands nearby as a light defender. Step 1: Jump off your left foot and lay it in off the backboard. Step 2: Catch the rebound on the left side while the defender lightly contests. Step 3: Finish through the contact with your left hand.
coaching_notes: Finish through contact, use the backboard, keep the ball high on the gather.

description: Start on the right wing around the three-point line with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Dribble to the rim with your right hand, reach toward the rim without jumping, and continue running through the basket. Step 2: Extend your right arm and release a soft finger roll off the backboard. Step 3: Retrieve the ball, return to the wing, and repeat.
coaching_notes: Attack from the wing at game speed, stay on the ground, extend fully, and run through the basket.

description: Start at the three-point line on the right wing — a partner passes to you on the move. Step 1: Catch the ball in stride without slowing down. Step 2: Take no more than two steps toward the basket. Step 3: Finish with a layup before the help defender arrives.
coaching_notes: Catch in stride, two steps max, finish high before the help arrives.

description: Start at the free-throw line with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive straight into the paint. Step 2: Pick up your dribble early while you are still a few feet from the rim. Step 3: Push a one-hand floater high over the imaginary tall defender.
coaching_notes: Release early, high arc, soft wrist — think 'push, don't throw.'

description: Start on the right wing with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive toward the basket at an angle. Step 2: Jump off your left foot as you approach the rim. Step 3: Finish with your right hand on the far side of the backboard (outside hand — away from your body).
coaching_notes: Extend away from the defender, use the backboard angle, protect with your body.

description: Start on the right block with the ball in both hands. Step 1: Drive toward the basket. Step 2: Gather the ball in an overhand cuff (ball on top of your hand, above your head). Step 3: Extend your arm fully through the finish at the rim.
coaching_notes: Cuff high, extend through the defender, finish with authority.

description: Start on the right side of the basket with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive toward the rim at a steep angle. Step 2: Jump off your left foot. Step 3: Release the ball overhand high off the backboard.
coaching_notes: Jump off the correct foot, release over the rim, use soft touch on the glass.

description: Start on the right block with your back to the basket and the ball in both hands. Step 1: Front pivot on your left foot to face the rim. Step 2: Take one power dribble toward the middle. Step 3: Finish with a right-hand baby hook from the right block.
coaching_notes: Pivot strong, chin on your shoulder, attack the defender's top foot.

description: Start on the right wing with the ball. Step 1: Drive toward the middle. Step 2: Jump stop on two feet inside the restricted area. Step 3: Power through contact and finish with two hands.
coaching_notes: Wide base on landing, absorb contact, finish high off the glass.

description: Start on the wing with the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: Attack the paint with the ball. Step 2: Two-foot pro hop when you see the rim protector. Step 3: Reverse layup on the opposite side of the rim using the backboard.
coaching_notes: Hop is explosive but balanced, eyes find the window on the reverse.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive toward the right side of the basket. Step 2: When help defense appears, hop laterally on both feet across the lane (pro hop). Step 3: Finish with a layup on the opposite side.
coaching_notes: Hop laterally on two feet, protect the ball, finish on the opposite side.

description: Start at the free-throw line with the ball in your shooting hand. Step 1: Dribble toward the basket and pull up like you are shooting. Step 2: Pump fake — bring the ball up to shoot but don't release, sell it with your eyes. Step 3: When the defender jumps, take one step and finish with an easy layup.
coaching_notes: Sell the fake with eyes and ball, low gather, finish strong at the rim.

description: Start on the right side of the basket with the ball in both hands. Step 1: Jump off both feet toward the rim. Step 2: Extend your body to the opposite (left) side of the basket in the air. Step 3: Finish with a reverse layup off the backboard.
coaching_notes: Jump off two feet, extend to the opposite side, use the backboard.

description: Start on the right side of the basket with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive under the basket toward the left side. Step 2: Jump off your right foot (outside foot). Step 3: Finish with a reverse layup on the left side of the rim, using the backboard.
coaching_notes: Jump off the outside foot, protect with your body, soft touch on the glass.

description: Start on the right wing in triple-threat position with the ball at your hip. Step 1: Rip the ball low across your body, then up to your right ear. Step 2: Explode off your first step toward the right side of the basket. Step 3: Finish a right-hand layup before the defender recovers.
coaching_notes: Rip low to high, elbow tight, explode off the first step.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: One dribble into the paint. Step 2: Pick up the ball on the same foot you attacked with. Step 3: Shoot a one-foot floater before the big rotates.
coaching_notes: Floater is soft, high arc, release before the second defender lands.

description: Start in the right baseline corner with the ball. Step 1: Take one hard dribble toward the right side of the rim. Step 2: Finish with an underhand finger roll over the imaginary contest.
coaching_notes: High arc, roll off the fingertips, use the backboard on tight angles.

description: Start on the right wing with the ball in your right hand — imagine a defender beside you. Step 1: Drive toward the basket shoulder-to-shoulder with the defender. Step 2: Slide past their hip, keeping the ball protected on your outside hand. Step 3: Finish with a layup on the move.
coaching_notes: Shoulder through the hip, protect the ball, finish on the move.

description: Start on the right wing with the ball. Step 1: Drive the right baseline. Step 2: When help cuts you off, plant your inside foot. Step 3: Spin back to the middle and finish a standard layup on the right side of the rim.
coaching_notes: Spin on inside foot, ball protected, explode out of the turn to the rim.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive toward the right side of the basket. Step 2: Plant your right foot and spin dribble back toward the left side, protecting the ball. Step 3: Finish with a layup on the opposite side of the rim.
coaching_notes: Protect the ball on the spin, jump off the inside foot, finish high.

description: Start on the block with a catch in an athletic stance. Step 1: Stride stop on two feet. Step 2: Shot fake by showing the ball high. Step 3: Step long and low under the leaping defender. Step 4: Finish with a layup.
coaching_notes: Sell the fake with eyes and ball, step through is long and low.

description: Start on the right block with the ball in both hands. Step 1: Push the ball from your outside hand to your inside hand and bringing your opposite foot over and spinning off of it. Step 2: Protect the ball tight to your chest through the spin. Step 3: Release a soft layup off the backboard as you come out of the spin.
coaching_notes: Stay compact through the spin, protect the ball, finish soft off the glass.

description: Start on the right side of the basket with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive close to the rim at a steep angle. Step 2: Jump off your left foot. Step 3: Release a soft underhand finger roll under the defender's reach and off the backboard.
coaching_notes: Release under the defender's reach, soft finger roll, use the backboard.

description: Start under the basket on the right side with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Jump off your left foot and finish with a regular layup. Step 2: Catch the rebound on the left side and finish with a hook shot. Step 3: Next rep, try a reverse or soft finger roll — change the finish each time.
coaching_notes: Change the finish each rep, stay on the correct foot, use the glass.

description: Start on the right block with the ball in both hands, back to the basket. Step 1: Catch or pick up the ball and face the basket with one dribble. Step 2: Jump off your left foot (inside foot). Step 3: Sweep your right arm in a wide hook motion and finish off the backboard.
coaching_notes: Sweep the arm wide, use the backboard, jump off the inside foot.

description: Start on the right wing at the three-point line with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive at a 45-degree angle toward the basket. Step 2: Jump off your left foot as you reach the paint. Step 3: Finish with a layup high off the backboard.
coaching_notes: Attack at a 45-degree angle, jump off the correct foot, finish high.

description: Start in the right corner with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Sprint diagonally across the paint to the left block and finish with a layup. Step 2: Rebound and sprint diagonally back to the right block and finish. Step 3: Keep running the X pattern — corner to opposite block and back.
coaching_notes: Sprint the X, gather under control, finish with the correct hand.

description: Start on the block with a post catch in an athletic stance. Step 1: Drop step middle and open your hip to the paint. Step 2: Rip through below the hand. Step 3: One power dribble. Step 4: Finish at the rim.
coaching_notes: Drop step opens the hip fully, rip is low, power dribble is north-south.

description: Start on the wing in triple-threat stance (ready to shoot, pass, or drive) with the ball. Step 1: Hip turn with a jab foot to load the drive. Step 2: Explosive first step toward the middle. Step 3: Reset and explosive first step toward the baseline.
coaching_notes: Hip turn is quick, first step covers maximum ground, stay low.

description: Start on the wing in triple-threat stance (ready to shoot, pass, or drive) with the ball. Step 1: Jab with your opposite foot. Step 2: Crossover step into your first step attack. Step 3: Finish the drive or reset.
coaching_notes: Jab is violent but controlled, crossover step is long, stay low.

description: Start in the mid-post with a catch in an athletic stance. Step 1: Dribble once. Step 2: Pivot on your inside foot toward the baseline. Step 3: Fadeaway jumper.
coaching_notes: Pivot on inside foot, fade on a straight line, high release.

description: Start on the sideline in an athletic stance. Step 1: Sprint along the sideline. Step 2: Plant at each lane line with a two-foot jump stop. Step 3: Explode to the next line.
coaching_notes: Jump stops are loud and balanced, explode out low.

description: Start on the wing with a catch in triple threat. Step 1: Front pivot into a jab and first step. Step 2: Reverse pivot into a jab and first step. Step 3: Sweep pivot into a jab and first step.
coaching_notes: Pivots stay tight, jab sells the drive, don't travel on the sweep.

exercise_name: Pivot Series triple-threat stance (ready to shoot, pass, or drive)
description: Start on the wing with a catch in triple-threat stance (ready to shoot, pass, or drive). Step 1: Front pivot into a jab and first step. Step 2: Reverse pivot into a jab and first step. Step 3: Sweep pivot into a jab and first step.
coaching_notes: Pivots stay tight, jab sells the drive, don't travel on the sweep.

description: Start at the baseline of a T-drill setup in an athletic stance. Step 1: Sprint forward 5 yards. Step 2: Shuffle left 5 yards. Step 3: Shuffle right 10 yards. Step 4: Shuffle left 5 yards. Step 5: Backpedal 5 yards.
coaching_notes: Low hips on shuffles, don't cross feet, touch every line.

exercise_name: Stride Stop Lateral Bound Into Shot
description: Start at the middle of the court (between the free-throw lines) without the ball in an athletic stance. Step 1: Lateral bound sideways with an explosive push. Step 2: Stride stop on two feet at the free-throw line extended. Step 3: Rise into a pull-up shot.
coaching_notes: Stick the stride stop, knees bent, shoot straight up.

description: Start at the free-throw line with a ball, facing the basket in an athletic stance. Step 1: Toss the ball to yourself or have a partner pass it. Step 2: Step with your right foot first, then your left foot (1-2 step) as you catch. Step 3: Rise straight up and shoot.
coaching_notes: Land on two feet square, dip into your hips, rise straight through the shot.

description: Start on the right wing behind the three-point line with the ball. Step 1: Shuffle two steps toward the baseline while staying behind the arc. Step 2: Stop on balance with a right-left 1-2 step. Step 3: Shoot the right-wing three.
coaching_notes: Chop your feet on the stop, gather 1-2, eyes on the rim before you lift.

description: Start behind the three-point line at the top of the key with the ball in your shooting hand, feet shoulder-width apart. Step 1: Catch the ball or pick up your dribble in triple-threat position. Step 2: Bring the ball up quickly in one smooth motion (the 'lift') without dipping it low. Step 3: Shoot with a high release and hold your follow-through.
coaching_notes: Elbow under the ball, full extension, hold follow-through until you land.

description: Start behind the three-point arc on the right wing with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Dribble one or two times like you are going to shoot a three. Step 2: Plant your inside foot (left foot) hard and step one foot inside the line. Step 3: Pull up for a mid-range jumper.
coaching_notes: Sell the three, plant your inside foot hard, rise into a balanced mid-range shot.

description: Start at the right elbow (free-throw line extended) facing the sideline with the ball. Step 1: Pivot on your left foot and turn 90 degrees to face the basket. Step 2: Set both feet on balance at the right elbow. Step 3: Shoot the right-elbow mid-range jumper.
coaching_notes: Turn on your inside foot, stay low through the pivot, explode into the next action.

description: Start at the center of the free-throw line with a basketball. Step 1: Sprint away from the spot, relocate back to it, catch on the move, set your feet quickly, and shoot. Step 2: Shoot the mid-range jumper and hold your follow-through until the ball reaches the rim. Step 3: Take 20 game-speed shots from this one spot with no extra gather step.
coaching_notes: Keep your shooting elbow under the ball and hold the follow-through. Create game pace before the catch while keeping the release balanced and repeatable.

description: Start at the right corner behind the three-point line with a basketball. Step 1: Sprint away from the spot, relocate back to it, catch on the move, set your feet quickly, and shoot. Step 2: Shoot the three-pointer and hold your follow-through until the ball reaches the rim. Step 3: Take 20 game-speed shots from this one spot with no extra gather step.
coaching_notes: Keep your toes and shoulders square despite the tight baseline angle. Create game pace before the catch while keeping the release balanced and repeatable.

description: Start at the right elbow at the free-throw line with a basketball. Step 1: Sprint away from the spot, relocate back to it, catch on the move, set your feet quickly, and shoot. Step 2: Shoot the mid-range jumper and hold your follow-through until the ball reaches the rim. Step 3: Take 20 game-speed shots from this one spot with no extra gather step.
coaching_notes: Stop on balance at the elbow and rise vertically. Create game pace before the catch while keeping the release balanced and repeatable.

coaching_notes: Stay centered behind the ball and finish straight through the rim. Create game pace before the catch while keeping the release balanced and repeatable.

exercise_name: Advanced Top of Key Three Spot-Up
description: Start at the top of the key behind the three-point line with a basketball. Step 1: Sprint away from the spot, relocate back to it, catch on the move, set your feet quickly, and shoot. Step 2: Shoot the three-pointer and hold your follow-through until the ball reaches the rim. Step 3: Take 20 game-speed shots from this one spot with no extra gather step.

coaching_notes: Point both feet toward the rim and avoid drifting toward the sideline. Create game pace before the catch while keeping the release balanced and repeatable.

description: Start on the right wing behind the three-point line with the ball. Step 1: Drive hard into the paint. Step 2: Take two controlled retreat dribbles back to the right wing. Step 3: Side-step toward the sideline. Step 4: Shoot the right-wing three.
coaching_notes: Retreat stays low and controlled, reload hips before the side step, no leaning back.

description: Start on the right wing facing the basket with the ball in triple-threat position. Step 1: Your defender is close — pivot on your left foot (back pivot) so your back turns toward them. Step 2: Square back up to the basket with space between you and the defender. Step 3: Rise into a mid-range pull-up jumper.
coaching_notes: Pivot on your inside foot, chin on your shoulder, square your hips before the shot.

description: Start at the top of the key facing the basket. Step 1: Spin the ball backward toward the right wing behind the three-point line. Step 2: Sprint to the right wing and meet the ball on the catch. Step 3: Set your feet and shoot the right-wing three without drifting.
coaching_notes: Meet the ball, load into your hips, don't drift backward on the shot.

description: Start in the right corner behind the three-point line with the ball. Step 1: Set your feet so your shoulders square to the rim. Step 2: Dip the ball into your shooting pocket while staying behind the line. Step 3: Shoot the right-corner three with a high arc.
coaching_notes: Stay behind the line, square your shoulders, and hold your follow-through.

description: Start at the center of the free-throw line. Step 1: Take 20 stationary center mid-range jumpers.
coaching_notes: Keep your elbow under the ball and hold your follow-through.

description: Start in the right corner behind the three-point line. Step 1: Take 20 stationary corner threes, then repeat the same set from the left corner.
coaching_notes: Set your feet, stay balanced, and hold your follow-through.

description: Start at the right elbow on the free-throw line. Step 1: Take 20 stationary mid-range jumpers, then repeat the same set from the left elbow.
coaching_notes: Rise straight up and land in the same spot.

description: Start at the top of the key behind the three-point line. Step 1: Take 20 stationary top-of-key threes.
coaching_notes: Stay centered and finish straight through the rim.

description: Start on the right wing behind the three-point line. Step 1: Take 20 stationary wing threes, then repeat the same set from the left wing.
coaching_notes: Square your feet and shoulders directly to the rim.

description: Start on the right wing inside the three-point line. Step 1: Take 20 stationary wing mid-range jumpers, then repeat the same set from the left wing.
coaching_notes: Stay balanced and avoid drifting toward the sideline.

description: Start at the center of the free-throw line with a basketball. Step 1: Spin the ball to yourself at the marked spot. Set both feet, bend your knees, and shoot without rushing. Step 2: Shoot the mid-range jumper and hold your follow-through until the ball reaches the rim. Step 3: Take 20 shots from this one spot, resetting your feet before every attempt.
coaching_notes: Keep your shooting elbow under the ball and hold the follow-through. Build identical foot placement and a repeatable release before adding speed.

description: Start at the right corner behind the three-point line with a basketball. Step 1: Spin the ball to yourself at the marked spot. Set both feet, bend your knees, and shoot without rushing. Step 2: Shoot the three-pointer and hold your follow-through until the ball reaches the rim. Step 3: Take 20 shots from this one spot, resetting your feet before every attempt.
coaching_notes: Keep your toes and shoulders square despite the tight baseline angle. Build identical foot placement and a repeatable release before adding speed.

coaching_notes: Keep your toes and shoulders square despite the tight baseline angle. Build identical foot placement and a repeatable release before adding speed.

description: Start at the right elbow at the free-throw line with a basketball. Step 1: Spin the ball to yourself at the marked spot. Set both feet, bend your knees, and shoot without rushing. Step 2: Shoot the mid-range jumper and hold your follow-through until the ball reaches the rim. Step 3: Take 20 shots from this one spot, resetting your feet before every attempt.
coaching_notes: Stop on balance at the elbow and rise vertically. Build identical foot placement and a repeatable release before adding speed.

description: Start at the right wing behind the three-point line with a basketball. Step 1: Spin the ball to yourself at the marked spot. Set both feet, bend your knees, and shoot without rushing. Step 2: Shoot the three-pointer and hold your follow-through until the ball reaches the rim. Step 3: Take 20 shots from this one spot, resetting your feet before every attempt.
coaching_notes: Point both feet toward the rim and avoid drifting toward the sideline. Build identical foot placement and a repeatable release before adding speed.

Step 3: Take 20 shots from this one spot, resetting your feet before every attempt.
coaching_notes: Stay centered behind the ball and finish straight through the rim. Build identical foot placement and a repeatable release before adding speed.

description: Start at the top of the key behind the three-point line with a basketball. Step 1: Spin the ball to yourself at the marked spot. description: Start on the right wing with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Take one setup dribble. Step 2: Dribble between your legs to your left hand. Step 3: Cross the ball hard back to your right hand. Step 4: Gather on two feet at the right elbow and shoot the right-elbow mid-range jumper.
coaching_notes: Eyes up on the cross, land on two feet square, don't fade away sideways.

description: Start under the basket with an imaginary screen at the right elbow. Step 1: Curl tightly around the screen to the right elbow. Step 2: Spin the ball ahead and meet it with your hands ready. Step 3: Plant your inside foot and shoot the right-elbow mid-range jumper without dribbling.
coaching_notes: Tight curl, hands ready early, plant your inside foot and rise into the shot.

description: Start in the right corner behind the three-point line. Step 1: Imagine your teammate drives and the defense collapses — sprint (crack back) from the corner up to the right wing. Step 2: Catch a pass with your feet already moving toward the wing. Step 3: Set your feet quickly and shoot a three-pointer.
coaching_notes: Drift to open space, feet set on the catch, quick lift into the three.

description: Start on the left block in a low defensive stance. Step 1: Defensive slide across the lane to the right block without crossing your feet. Step 2: Sprint to the right-wing mid-range spot and close out with a high hand. Step 3: Reset on offense at that spot and shoot the right-wing mid-range jumper.
coaching_notes: Stay low in slides, don't cross feet, contest with verticality.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Make two quick crossovers. Step 2: Attack the center of the paint with one hard dribble. Step 3: Pick up the ball on your last step. Step 4: Shoot a one-foot floater from the paint.
coaching_notes: Ball on a tight string through the crosses, floater off the outside hand with soft touch.

description: Start on the right wing behind the three-point line in triple-threat stance. Step 1: Take one gather dribble and drag your top foot back while pulling the ball into your shooting pocket. Step 2: Rise immediately into the right-wing three.
coaching_notes: Drag step loads the hips, ball to pocket fast, no pause at the top of the shot.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drift laterally to the right-wing mid-range spot while dribbling. Step 2: Plant both feet without crossing back toward the middle. Step 3: Shoot the right-wing mid-range pull-up.
coaching_notes: Drift at game speed, feet set before lift, shoulders square to the rim.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Dribble one or two times toward the right elbow (free-throw line extended). Step 2: Plant your inside foot and gather on balance. Step 3: Pull up for a mid-range jumper.
coaching_notes: Attack the elbow, gather on balance, high release over the defense.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Dribble toward an imaginary screen on the right. Step 2: Fake the reject, then attack to the right elbow. Step 3: Plant on two feet. Step 4: Shoot the right-elbow mid-range jumper.
coaching_notes: Sell the reject with eyes and shoulders, plant on two feet, quick release.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand in a low stance. Step 1: Dribble a figure 8 through your legs — right hand to left hand and back. Step 2: Without pausing, gather the ball on balance. Step 3: Rise into a pull-up jumper.
coaching_notes: Stay low through the figure 8, gather quickly, square to the rim on the shot.

description: Start 3 feet in front of the basket facing the hoop, ball in your shooting hand. Step 1: Set your feet shoulder-width apart with knees slightly bent. Step 2: Place the ball in your shooting pocket (near your hip and chest) with your elbow under the ball. Step 3: Shoot slowly — balance, eyes on target, elbow in, follow through until the ball drops.
coaching_notes: Balance, eyes on target, elbow in, follow through until the ball drops.

description: Start directly in front of the basket, about 1 foot away, with the ball in your shooting hand. Step 1: Remove your guide hand — shoot with one hand only. Step 2: Snap your wrist and extend your arm fully on every release. Step 3: Try to swish without the ball touching the rim.
coaching_notes: Shoot with one hand, guide hand off early, swish without hitting the rim.

description: Start on the right block with the ball in both hands, back to the basket. Step 1: Dribble once and spin halfway around toward the middle. Step 2: Face the basket and jump backward slightly to create space. Step 3: Shoot the right-block short-range fadeaway.
coaching_notes: Spin tight, eyes on the rim, fade on balance with high arc.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Dribble toward the right elbow and pause with a hesitation. Step 2: When the imaginary defender freezes, plant both feet at the right elbow. Step 3: Shoot the right-elbow mid-range pull-up.
coaching_notes: Sell the hesi with your shoulders, rise straight up, don't lean back.

description: Start on the right wing with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Attack toward the middle and pause with a hesitation dribble. Step 2: Cross the ball back to your right hand. Step 3: Step back behind the right-wing three-point line. Step 4: Shoot the right-wing three.
coaching_notes: Freeze on the hesi with your eyes on the rim, push off the front foot on the step-back.

description: Start at the top of the key behind the three-point line with the ball. Step 1: Toss the ball forward to the center of the free-throw line. Step 2: Run to the ball and hop onto both feet as you catch. Step 3: Shoot the center free-throw-line mid-range jumper.
coaching_notes: Hop on two feet square, load into your hips, shoot on the way up.

description: Start on the right wing with the ball in your shooting hand. Step 1: Shuffle two steps toward the baseline. Step 2: Hop off both feet to stop on balance. Step 3: Shoot a pull-up without drifting sideways.
coaching_notes: Stick the hop, don't drift sideways, square your shoulders before the release.

description: Start under the basket with a pile of balls (or one ball you retrieve each time). Step 1: Sprint to the first spot (right corner) — the floor is 'hot lava' so move fast! Step 2: Catch or pick up the ball and shoot immediately. Step 3: Sprint to the next spot before the lava gets you.
coaching_notes: Sprint to the spot, feet ready on the catch, shoot without hesitation.

exercise_name: In n Out Cross/Legs into Jumper
description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: In-and-out fake to your right — fake like you are pushing the ball that way. Step 2: Crossover to your left hand, then push the ball through your legs back to your right hand. Step 3: Rise into a pull-up jumper.
coaching_notes: Stay low through the combo, gather on balance, quick release.

exercise_name: In n Out Crossover into Jumper
description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: In-and-out fake to your right — fake like you are pushing the ball that way. Step 2: Hard crossover to your left hand. Step 3: Plant your feet and shoot your pull-up.
coaching_notes: Pause on the in-and-out, sharp crossover, rise straight into the shot.

exercise_name: In n Out Dribble into Jumper
description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: In-and-out fake to your right — fake like you are pushing the ball that way. Step 2: Plant both feet and gather the ball. Step 3: Shoot your pull-up jumper.
coaching_notes: Freeze the defender with the hesi, plant and rise, hold follow-through.

description: Start at the center of the free-throw line with a basketball. Step 1: Spin the ball out, step into the catch with a one-two gather, and shoot immediately on balance. Step 2: Shoot the mid-range jumper and hold your follow-through until the ball reaches the rim. Step 3: Take 20 game-speed shots from this one spot and track makes.
coaching_notes: Keep your shooting elbow under the ball and hold the follow-through. Arrive low with hands ready so the catch flows directly into the shot.

description: Start at the right corner behind the three-point line with a basketball. Step 1: Spin the ball out, step into the catch with a one-two gather, and shoot immediately on balance. description: Start on the right wing in triple-threat position with the ball in both hands. Step 1: Jab step hard with your left foot like you are driving baseline. Step 2: Take one explosive dribble middle with your right hand. Step 3: Pull up for a mid-range jumper.
coaching_notes: Jab with purpose, one explosive dribble, pull up on balance.

description: Start under the basket with balls at 5 three-point spots (corners, wings, top). Step 1: Sprint to the first spot (right corner). Step 2: Catch, set your feet, and shoot a three. Step 3: Sprint to the next spot and repeat — try to make as many as you can in 2 minutes.
coaching_notes: Sprint between spots, set your feet on every catch, consistent release point.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand and a cone in front of you. Step 1: Dribble in a wide loop around the cone to your right. Step 2: Keep the ball protected on the outside of your body as you circle. Step 3: Stop in the center mid-range area and shoot the pull-up jumper.
coaching_notes: Keep the ball protected on the loop, change pace, finish decisively.

description: Start on the right wing in triple-threat position with the ball in both hands. Step 1: Jab step hard with your left foot toward the baseline. Step 2: Pivot back on your inside foot to square up to the basket. Step 3: Rise into a pull-up jumper.
coaching_notes: Jab to create space, pivot on your inside foot, rise into a balanced jumper.

description: Start under the basket without the ball. Step 1: Sprint a tight curl to the right wing behind the three-point line. Step 2: Spin the ball ahead to the right wing and meet it with your hands ready. Step 3: Use one-two footwork and shoot the right-wing three without dribbling.
coaching_notes: Hands up before the catch, dip into hips, land on two feet on the shot.

description: Start in the right corner behind the three-point line with the ball. Step 1: Simulate a teammate's baseline drive-and-kick by spinning the ball ahead to the right wing. Step 2: Sprint directly to the right wing with your hands ready. Step 3: Catch on balance and shoot the right-wing three.
coaching_notes: Sprint through the catch, feet down before the ball arrives, no extra dribble.

description: Start on the right wing facing the basket in triple-threat stance. Step 1: Rip the ball low below your knee to your right hand. Step 2: Take one hard dribble to the right elbow. Step 3: Stop on balance and shoot the right-elbow mid-range jumper.
coaching_notes: Rip tight to the body, chin on shoulder on the gather, straight up on the shot.

exercise_name: Rocker Step Into Side Step Three
description: Start on the right wing behind the three-point line in triple-threat stance with the ball. Step 1: Shot fake by rocking up. Step 2: Drive fake by rocking down. Step 3: Take one dribble toward the middle. Step 4: Side-step back to the right wing and shoot the three.
coaching_notes: Sell both fakes with shoulders, stay tall on the side step, high release.

description: Start 5 feet in front of the basket with no ball, feet shoulder-width apart. Step 1: Bend your knees and set your shooting pocket (hands up like you are holding a ball). Step 2: Go through your full shooting motion — extend your arm and snap your wrist. Step 3: Hold your follow-through until you 'make' the imaginary shot.
coaching_notes: Full extension, hold follow-through, feel the same rhythm every rep.

description: Start at the free-throw line facing the basket with no ball, hands up like you are catching a pass. Step 1: Practice a 1-2 step (right foot, then left foot) as if catching and shooting. Step 2: Practice a two-foot hop gather into a shot. Step 3: Practice a pivot into a pull-up.
coaching_notes: 1-2 or hop footwork, square hips, same timing as a real shot.

description: Start 3 feet in front of the basket with the ball in your right hand only — no guide hand. Step 1: Set your feet and place the ball in your shooting pocket. Step 2: Extend your arm and snap your wrist on the release. Step 3: Hold follow-through until the ball goes through.
coaching_notes: Guide hand off, elbow under the ball, snap wrist on every release.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Size up with two hard dribbles in place. Step 2: Take one balanced step-back directly behind the top-of-key three-point line. Step 3: Rise into the top-of-key three.
coaching_notes: Sell the size-up, create space with a step, rise into a balanced three.

description: Start on the right wing behind the three-point line with the ball. Step 1: Attack middle with two dribbles. Step 2: Snatch the ball back with one hard crossover. Step 3: Step back to the right wing behind the three-point line. Step 4: Shoot the right-wing three.
coaching_notes: Snatch is low and quick, step-back lands balanced, shoot on the way up.

description: Start at half court with the ball. Step 1: Sprint full speed down the center of the court. Step 2: Drop your hips and stop suddenly on two feet behind the top-of-key three-point line. Step 3: Shoot the top-of-key three without drifting.
coaching_notes: Drop your hips on the stop, stick the landing, rise straight up.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Drive toward the right side — when the lane closes, plant your right foot. Step 2: Spin tight and low back toward the middle, keeping the ball protected. Step 3: Without pausing, rise into a pull-up jumper.
coaching_notes: Spin tight and low, gather on balance, shoot before the defense recovers.

exercise_name: Stationary Dribble into Behind Back Jumper
description: Start at the free-throw line with the ball in your right hand in a low stance. Step 1: Dribble in place two or three times. Step 2: Go behind your back to switch to your left hand. Step 3: Gather and shoot a pull-up jumper.
coaching_notes: Stay low through the move, gather quickly, square to the rim on the shot.

exercise_name: Stationary Dribble into Between Legs Jumper
description: Start at the free-throw line with the ball in your right hand in a low stance. Step 1: Dribble in place two or three times. Step 2: Push the ball through your legs to your left hand. Step 3: Gather and shoot a pull-up jumper.
coaching_notes: Push through your legs hard, rise on balance, quick release.

description: Start at the free-throw line with the ball in your right hand in a low stance. Step 1: Dribble in place two or three times. Step 2: Sharp crossover to your left hand. Step 3: Plant your inside foot and rise into a pull-up jumper.
coaching_notes: Sharp crossover, plant the inside foot, rise straight into the shot.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand in an athletic stance. Step 1: Take one dribble to the right. Step 2: Hard step-back to create space. Step 3: Take a small side-step to the left. Step 4: Shoot the three.
coaching_notes: First step-back must be balanced; second step is small and crisp, not a hop.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Dribble toward your defender like you are driving. Step 2: Push off your front foot and step backward with a hard step-back dribble to create space. Step 3: Rise into a mid-range pull-up — stay balanced, don't fade sideways.
coaching_notes: Push off hard, step back on balance, don't fade sideways.

description: Start at half court with the ball. Step 1: Dribble full speed down the center of the court. Step 2: Take one hard pound dribble as you reach the top of the key. Step 3: Stop on a dime with a one-two gather. Step 4: Shoot the top-of-key three.
coaching_notes: Pound dribble is violent, stop is loud, upper body stays back over feet.

description: Start on the right wing in triple-threat position — ball in both hands, knees bent, ready to shoot, pass, or drive. Step 1: Read the imaginary defender and make a quick jab or rip. Step 2: Bring the ball up in one smooth motion. Step 3: Shoot a three-pointer without extra dribbles.
coaching_notes: Shot-ready on the catch, quick lift, no wasted motion before the release.

description: Start at the top of the key with the ball in your right hand. Step 1: Take two hard dribbles toward the right elbow. Step 2: Plant your inside foot and gather on balance. Step 3: Pull up for a mid-range jumper.
coaching_notes: Two hard dribbles max, gather on balance, rise into a high release.

description: Start 6 feet away from a flat wall with the ball in your shooting hand. Step 1: Set your feet and go through your normal shooting form. Step 2: Shoot the ball at a spot on the wall about 10 feet high — focus on backspin and arc. Step 3: Catch the rebound off the wall and shoot again immediately.
coaching_notes: Same shooting form as a real shot, focus on backspin and arc.

description: Start on the right block with your back to the basket and the ball. Step 1: Take one dribble toward the middle. Step 2: Plant your inside foot and turn over your baseline shoulder. Step 3: Shoot the right-side baseline mid-range fadeaway.
coaching_notes: Pivot on the inside foot, fade on a straight line, high release over the hand.

description: Start under the basket — four spots form an X: right corner, left wing, top of key, left corner. Step 1: Sprint to the right corner and catch a pass. Step 2: Set your feet and shoot. Step 3: Sprint to the next X spot (left wing), shoot, then continue to the top and left corner.
coaching_notes: Sprint to each spot, set your feet on the catch, consistent release every time.

description: Forward, lateral, and reverse lunges in a continuous matrix for lower-body strength and stability. Supports deceleration and landing mechanics.
coaching_notes: Knee tracks over toe, torso tall, controlled tempo.

description: Lateral bounds with a two-second stick on landing. Builds eccentric strength for defensive slides and cutting.
coaching_notes: Stick the landing quietly, knees soft, don't collapse inward.

description: Single-leg Romanian deadlift for hamstring/glute strength and ankle stability — critical for cutting and landing in games.
coaching_notes: Hinge at the hip, slight knee bend, square hips, slow on the way down.
